name: Nagarjuna Agri Tech Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1987, Nagarjuna Agri Tech Ltd is in the business of cultivating and selling of Roses in India and abroad[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
NATL operates modern floriculture units near Bangalore, spanning approximately 5 hectares of covered area. The company follows an integrated rose production model, including in-house plantation, cultivation, and distribution capabilities. It offers a variety of product baskets (small, medium, and large) for global markets and specializes in Dutch rose varieties tailored to international preferences.
